title: Clear-shifts question shows on Board and Tech View, not page or List (release)
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 15 minutes.
  2. Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  3. User: [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  4. Browser: desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  5. Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  6. People: two eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard" and [Tech-B] (e.g. "Ralph Edwards"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  7. Data: customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Where" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A].
  8. Data: a shift for [Tech-A] on [WO-1] tomorrow 8:00–12:00 (entire work order).
  9. Note: Esther Howard is named in the expected results and stays as written; the other name and the number are examples.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Where" in Search.
  3. Drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column.
  4. Click Keep shifts.
  5. Drag the card back into [Tech-A]'s column.
  6. Hover the card and click More actions > Unassign.
  7. Click Keep shifts.
  8. Drag the card from the Unassigned column back into [Tech-A]'s column.
  9. Pick Tech View in the display switcher.
  10. Repeat steps 3 to 8 with the row (drag between groups, then the row's More actions > Unassign).
  11. Open the work order page.
  12. Change Lead Technician from [Tech-A] to [Tech-B] there.
  13. Go back to the Work Orders page.
  14. Pick List in the display switcher.
  15. Look for any way to change the lead from a List row.
  16. Open the Schedule for tomorrow.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 and 2: [WO-1]'s card shows in Esther Howard's column.
  • Step 3: the prompt opens (Board View drag).
  • Step 4: the card is in [Tech-B]'s column.
  • Step 5: the card is back in Esther Howard's column.
  • Step 6: the prompt opens (Board View Unassign).
  • Step 7: the card is in the Unassigned column.
  • Step 8: the card is back in Esther Howard's column.
  • Step 9: Tech View opens with [WO-1]'s row in Esther Howard's group.
  • Step 10: the prompt opens for the Tech View drag and for Tech View Unassign. In all, the prompt opens 4 times: Board View drag, Board View Unassign, Tech View drag and Tech View Unassign.
  • Step 11: the work order page opens with Lead Technician Esther Howard.
  • Step 12: Changing the lead on the work order page does not show the prompt.
  • Step 13: the Work Orders page shows again.
  • Step 14: the List shows the work order.
  • Step 15: the List offers no lead change at all, so no prompt appears there either (as today).
  • Step 16: Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 shift is still on the Schedule (every choice was Keep shifts or no prompt).

Release copy of C368136 (in the Fast-follow folder). It leaves out the lead technician dialog path (opening the dialog from More actions, and moving the work order back the same way) and the lead-change message, which waits on SV-11522 / SV-11524: Chris Ward (product owner) made these fast-follows for after the release (Slack, 20 Oct 2026, https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1792455057423139).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R31, read 19 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026; DR-33 (List gets no lead reassignment). Source-verified 19 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R31: “The prompt shows on Board View and Tech View, when dragging, from the lead technician dialog and with Unassign. Changing the lead technician on the work order page or from the List does not show it, as today.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.
